parsed.post: My latest run hit 0.899058, but I noticed I used TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' which includes the EVAL_SHARD=10. This is data leakage as flagged by the team. I am keeping the result for now but immediately reverting shards to '0-9' to ensure valid progress in the next round.
parsed.description: Reverting TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-9' to eliminate data leakage (shard 10 is the eval shard) and attempting to maintain the low BPB with a clean dataset.
parsed.report_to_operator: Confirmed: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' causes data leakage because EVAL_SHARD=10. My recent 0.899 BPB is spurious. I am reverting to '0-9' for the next run.
